messages.text:
"Create a massive quality open-world action-adventure game titled ROYAL KING: THE UNDERWORLD, inspired by the cinematic realism, freedom, and immersive gameplay of GTA 6.
1. GAME WORLD
Build a huge, highly detailed open world featuring:
A modern Indian mega-city.
Royal palaces and luxury mansions.
Highways, beaches, villages, mountains, airports and underground crime districts.
Dynamic weather, realistic day/night cycles and traffic.
Living NPCs with realistic AI behaviour.
2. MAIN CHARACTER
The player is a young Indian royal heir who secretly controls a powerful criminal empire.
Stylish outfits and royal traditional costumes.
Customizable hairstyle, beard and accessories.
Luxury lifestyle, private jets and supercars.
Character progression and reputation system.
3. ACTION GAMEPLAY
Third-person shooting and hand-to-hand combat.
High-speed car and bike chases.
Police pursuit and wanted-level system.
Gang wars and territory control.
Stealth missions and heists.
Explosions, cinematic boss fights and dramatic escapes.
4. VEHICLES
Include supercars, superbikes, SUVs, helicopters, private jets, boats and military vehicles. Allow complete vehicle customization.
5. ROYAL LIFESTYLE
Own royal palaces and luxury villas.
Build a criminal empire.
Hire bodyguards and personal staff.
Purchase expensive watches, clothes and jewellery.
Host royal parties and attend exclusive events.
6. STORY MODE
Create a 30–40 hour cinematic story with unexpected betrayals, family rivalries, political conspiracies, gang wars, revenge and a powerful final showdown.
7. GRAPHICS
Photorealistic graphics. environments.
Realistic facial animations.
Advanced lighting, reflections and shadows.
Cinematic cutscenes.
Immersive sound design and original background music.
8. GAME FEATURES
Open-world exploration.
Single-player story and optional multiplayer.
Realistic driving physics.
Interactive buildings.
Dynamic conversations.
Save/load system.
Controller and mobile support.
FINAL GOAL:
Create an incredibly immersive, visually stunning open-world royal action game with the freedom of GTA 6, the atmosphere of an Indian crime thriller, and the fantasy of living like a billionaire king. Make the experience original, ambitious and unforgettable.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
